Accordion.Item.description: One section of an accordion: its heading, a button with a plus or minus at its start, and the panel below it.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading that opens and closes the section, in medium weight: say what the panel holds, such as a question it answers. Given as undefined, such as over a placeholder item, a skeleton shows a bar in its place.

props.name: children
props.description: The panel, in muted text lined up with the title, shown while the item is open.

props.name: value
props.description: Names the item in the accordion's value, for an accordion that is controlled or opens items at first. Without it, the item takes a generated one.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The item ignores presses and can't be focused; it stays dimmed.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Receives whether this item is open, each time it opens or closes.

props.name: end
props.description: Content at the end of the item's heading row, beside its button and outside it, such as a Switch, a Badge with a Menu, or a Delete IconButton, placed as given.

props.name: indicator
props.description: What shows in this item's button whether it is open, in place of the Root's indicator, such as a chevron the application turns while the button has data-panel-open; null for none.

props.name: indicatorPlacement
props.description: Where this item's indicator sits in its button: before the title, or after it at the button's end.

Accordion.Root.description: A list of sections, each a heading that shows and hides its panel, separated by full-width hairlines. A plus at the start of a heading becomes a minus while its section is open. One item is open at a time unless `multiple` is set.

props.name: children
props.description: The items: Accordion.Item, one for each section.

props.name: value
props.description: The values of the open items, for a controlled accordion: update it from onValueChange. Use defaultValue instead to leave it to the accordion.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The values of the items open at first, for an accordion that keeps its own state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the values of the open items, each time an item opens or closes.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Lets several items be open at once; otherwise opening one closes the one that was open.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The level of each item's heading, for the page's outline; they look the same at every level.

props.name: indicator
props.description: What shows in every item's button whether the item is open, in place of the plus that becomes a minus, such as a chevron the application turns while the button has data-panel-open; null for none. It is hidden from assistive technology, which hears the button's expanded state. An item's own indicator replaces it.

props.name: indicatorPlacement
props.description: Where every item's indicator sits in its button: before the title, or after it at the button's end. An item's own indicatorPlacement replaces it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Every item ignores presses and can't be focused.

props.name: hiddenUntilFound
props.description: Keeps closed panels in the page, hidden until found, so the browser's find in page reaches their text and opens the item that holds it, where the browser supports it.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Shows it and its content as a busy skeleton while that loads; turning it on or off renders the content anew.

Alert.description: An inline banner for a page- or section-level message, in its tone. It is a server component; its dismiss button is an IconButton with a cross, named in the provider's language.

props.name: tone
props.description: What the message means: info, success, warning or danger, for an error or a failure. Sets the tint, the title's and icon's color and the icon; info and success alerts are also status messages.

props.name: title
props.description: A short heading for the message, such as "Sync paused", above the message: text, or content such as a branch name in Code or a link.

props.name: children
props.description: The message: what it means and what people can do.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the tone's icon; null or false shows none.

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions below the message, such as a Button or a Link, in a row that wraps.

props.name: actionsPlacement
props.description: Where the actions go: below the message, or at the end of the alert's row, before the dismiss button, as in a one-line banner such as "Sync paused. Resume". At the end, they move below the message where the alert is too narrow for both.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a dismiss button that calls it; the application removes the alert.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button, also shown as its tooltip.

props.name: announce
props.description: The alert appeared because of something that just happened and should interrupt: warning and danger alerts take the alert role. Info and success alerts are always polite status messages.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Shows it and its content as a busy skeleton while that loads; turning it on or off renders the content anew.

Avatar.description: A round picture of a person or organization, with their initials or the default person picture as fallback.

props.name: name
props.description: Person or organization name: the accessible name of a named avatar, and the initials fallback.

props.name: src
props.description: Picture URL. The fallback shows while it loads and when it is missing or fails.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown without a picture: the initials of `name`, so people tell avatars apart, or the default person picture, which an empty `name` shows too. An element is placed as given on the hue's fill, in its deep shade as `currentColor`, such as an icon or a Graphic for a bot, an agent, a team or a service account.

props.name: hue
props.description: The fill behind the initials or the person picture. Without it, the name chooses one, the same for the same name everywhere; set it for an organization with a color of its own.

props.name: size
props.description: sm 1.5 rem, md 2 rem, lg 3 rem or xl 5.5 rem, such as for a profile page.

props.name: named
props.description: Names the avatar as an image by `name`. Without it, the avatar is hidden from assistive technology, for when text beside it already names the person.

props.name: selected
props.description: Shows the avatar as chosen, such as in a list of people to pick from: a ring around it and a small check at its bottom end, so the choice never rests on color alone. It is a look only: the control around the avatar, such as a checkbox or an option, says it is chosen.

props.name: badge
props.description: A small mark at the avatar's bottom end, placed as given, such as a presence dot, an unread marker or an organization's mark; at its top end while the avatar is selected, whose check takes the bottom end. It is hidden from assistive technology with the avatar, so say what it shows in the text beside it.

AvatarButton.description: A person's avatar as a button, typically the account menu trigger in a topbar. A halo shows hover, press and an open menu, and the tooltip names the account.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name: shown in the tooltip, and the accessible name unless aria-label is set, followed by a badge's text, such as Alex Morgan, online.

props.name: description
props.description: A second tooltip line, such as the e-mail address of the signed-in account, or content such as an organization's name with its plan's Badge.

props.name: src
props.description: Picture URL; the fallback shows without one.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown without a picture: the initials of `name`, by default, or the default person picture.

props.name: hue
props.description: The fill behind the initials or the person picture, as for Avatar; the name chooses one by default.

props.name: selected
props.description: Shows the avatar as chosen, as for Avatar: a ring and a check. A look only.

props.name: badge
props.description: A small mark at the avatar's bottom end, as for Avatar, such as a presence dot. Text, such as online, also follows the name in the button's accessible name, as it shows on the button.

props.name: size
props.description: The picture: sm 1.5 rem, md 2 rem or lg 3 rem, inside a slightly larger hit area, which grows to the touch height under a coarse pointer.

AvatarGroup.description: A pile of avatars for a set of people, such as the members of a project, with a chip that counts the rest and lists them in its tooltip. Hover, a tap or keyboard focus spreads it.

props.name: people
props.description: The people, in order. Pass a preview with total when there are many more.

props.name: max
props.description: The most avatars to show; the overflow chip after them counts the rest. All by default.

props.name: size
props.description: As Avatar: sm 1.5 rem, md 2 rem, lg 3 rem or xl 5.5 rem.

props.name: align
props.description: The group keeps the room its spread takes, so spreading never moves what is around it, and the pile rests at one end of that room, along the inline axis: start, or end for a group at the end of a row, such as at a list row's end.

props.name: total
props.description: How many people there are in all, when people is only a preview of them.

props.name: onPersonClick
props.description: Makes every avatar a button with a name tooltip; receives the person pressed. The avatars are targets only while the group is spread: at rest the pile is one target, which hover, a tap or keyboard focus spreads.

props.name: formatMore
props.description: Text for people beyond the list, in the overflow tooltip and the group's name. It overrides EnvUIProvider's `messages.avatarGroup.more` for this group.

props.name: formatLabel
props.description: The group's name from the number of people and their names, which end with formatMore's text for people counted in total but not listed, such as "3 people: Alex Morgan, Sam Lee, 1 more". It overrides EnvUIProvider's `messages.avatarGroup.label` for this group; aria-label replaces it.

props.name: renderOverflowTooltip
props.description: The overflow chip's tooltip, from the people it hides and how many more total counts but people doesn't list, such as a list of them with their avatars. Their names, one a line, and formatMore's text by default. The chip's accessible name stays their names.

Badge.description: A small pill label for a state, such as In progress, Blocked or Archived, or for neutral metadata, such as a plan or a count of seats; with count, a compact count, such as 12 unread.

props.name: start
props.description: Content before the label, such as an icon, a small Avatar or a color swatch: an envUI icon takes the badge's icon size and other content keeps its own. Assistive technology reads it unless it hides itself, as an icon without a label does. A done badge leads with a check mark unless it is given another start, or `null` for none.

props.name: children
props.description: The label: a state, a name or a category in a word or two, such as text with a bold value or a RelativeTime in it. It stays on one line and ends with an ellipsis where the badge is wider than its container.

props.name: count
props.description: A count, such as 12, or short text such as 99+, in place of a label: a compact round pill, in tabular figures, as beside a navigation label, in a tab or on a button.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning of the state: primary is the blue of what is current, accent the purple that stands out, done the quiet slate of completed work, which leads with a check mark. Neutral by default. A count in the primary tone, solid, draws attention, such as unread messages that need an answer.

props.name: variant
props.description: soft tints the background, solid fills it with the tone, outline draws a border.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the count means, such as 12 unread, which assistive technology reads in place of the number; the number alone otherwise.

Box.description: A plain block for what needs no row or column of its own: an inset (`padding`), a size container (`container`) or a named node. It sizes to its content and never paints.

props.name: render
props.description: The element to render, for its meaning, such as render={<section />} or render={<ul />}, or another component to lay out without a wrapper, such as a Surface: the primitive's attributes merge into its props. It must forward native props and refs. A div by default.

props.name: ref
props.description: The rendered element, a div by default. Its type is the element type parameter, which a ref passed in sets: a ref to the element that render makes, such as useRef<HTMLElement>(null) with render={<section />}, type-checks.

props.name: name
props.description: A name for this node, such as "filters" or "summary", for the application's styles and tests to find it by; it renders as `data-env-name`. A component's part class names its node instead.

props.name: container
props.description: Makes the element a size container of this name, for container queries on its inline size, such as container="filters" for `@container filters (width >= 37.5rem)`. A container is as wide as its context gives it, never as its content. container="env-window" makes the element a window of its own on purpose, such as a preview frame, whose content lays out at its window class; other `env-*` names are envUI's own.

props.name: padding
props.description: The inset on every side, a step of the spacing scale. None by default.

Breadcrumbs.description: The path from the top level to the current page; earlier levels are links.

props.name: items
props.description: From the top level to the current page, which is last.

props.name: wrap
props.description: The trail wraps onto more lines when it runs out of room; true by default. False keeps it on one line, for a bar or header: the current page is cut short first, and earlier levels keep their width.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark; name each trail where a page has several.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the `nav` element.

Button.description: Starts an action, or goes to a destination with href, in one of five variants and three tones, with optional icons. It renders a native button or link. An icon alone is an IconButton.

props.name: variant
props.description: The emphasis, primary for a group's main action; without it, the container's, such as ghost in a toolbar, and else primary.

props.name: tone
props.description: The meaning: neutral for most actions, danger for one that deletes or ends something, and accent, on a primary only, for a main action that must stand apart from the brand blue.

props.name: underline
props.description: Show an underline for the text variant.

props.name: size
props.description: The control height, sm, md or lg; without it, the container's, and else md.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fill the width of the container, such as the actions of a narrow form stacked in a column.

props.name: start
props.description: Content before the label, such as IconAdd, or a small Avatar of the person a button assigns: an envUI icon takes the button's icon size and other content keeps its own. It is hidden from assistive technology, since the label names the button.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: A decorative icon after the label, such as a ChevronRight for a next step.

props.name: end
props.description: Quiet content at the far end, such as a shortcut's Kbd, with aria-hidden on its keys and aria-keyshortcuts on the button.

props.name: pending
props.description: Its work is running: a spinner turns over it, it keeps its width and name, and presses do nothing.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled button cannot be pressed; a disabled link has no destination, cannot be focused or followed, and reports aria-disabled.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination: the element is a native link, through the LinkProvider's link component.

props.name: render
props.description: Another element to render the button as, such as a label for a file input, or a router's own link in one place: the button's class, look, state attributes, content and handlers merge into its props. It takes no type or disabled attribute; disabled reports aria-disabled and blocks presses.

ButtonGroup.description: Connected buttons keep their own outer corners and share the row inner radius.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A row of buttons, or a column in which every button is as wide as the group.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fill the container's width, such as a sidebar's: in a row, labelled buttons share the room the icon-only ones leave, which keep their square size, and a row of icon-only buttons shares it evenly; in a column, every button is as wide as the group.

Calendar.description: A month of days to choose one from, following the WAI-ARIA date picker grid: the arrow keys move by day and week, Page Up and Page Down by month (with Shift, by year), Home and End to the week's ends, and Enter or Space chooses the day. Named with aria-label or aria-labelledby, or by the List.Item whose control it is, it is a group around the month's grid.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen day as YYYY-MM-DD, or null for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The day an uncontrolled calendar starts with; none by default, which shows today's month.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the chosen day as YYYY-MM-DD.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day that can be chosen, as YYYY-MM-DD; earlier days are unavailable.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest day that can be chosen, as YYYY-MM-DD; later days are unavailable.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Whether a day, as YYYY-MM-DD, can't be chosen, such as a weekend, a holiday or a booked day; it shows dimmed and reports aria-disabled, as days outside min and max do, and the keyboard still moves onto it.

props.name: renderDay
props.description: The content of a day's mark in place of its number, such as the number with a dot under it for a day with events, or a price; it receives the day as YYYY-MM-DD and its state. The cell keeps its role, its name, the full date, and its keyboard handling.

props.name: weekStart
props.default: the locale's, or Monday where the browser cannot tell
props.description: The first day of each week, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the month and weekday names and the day numbers: EnvUIProvider's, else the browser's. The days are always Gregorian, also in a locale with a calendar of its own.

props.name: previousMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous month button.

props.name: nextMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next month button.

Card.description: A rounded surface that groups content about one subject: a content card with an optional title row and actions, or one link or button.

props.name: background
props.description: The fill: muted, the standalone card fill; default, a quieter fill that groups content, such as a section of a settings page; or page, the page's own color, for a card inside a pane.

props.name: padding
props.default: 1.25 rem in narrow windows, growing to 1.5 rem from 50 rem wide
props.description: The inset on every side, as a step of the spacing scale, such as 6 for 2 rem; 0 removes it. Without it, the inset follows the window's width.

props.name: className
props.description: The card's class, beside env-card.

props.name: style
props.description: Styles of the card.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Shows it and its content as a busy skeleton while that loads; turning it on or off renders the content anew.

props.name: title
props.description: The card's title at the top: an `h3` in the title type. headingLevel sets another level. Given as undefined, such as over a placeholder item, a skeleton shows a bar in its place.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's heading level, for the page's outline; the type stays the title type.

props.name: meta
props.description: A short fact at the end of the title row, such as when the card was updated.

props.name: headerEnd
props.description: Content at the end of the title row, after the meta, such as an overflow Menu or an Edit Button, placed as given.

props.name: description
props.description: A sentence under the title, in muted text.

props.name: actions
props.description: The card's controls, such as Buttons, in a strip along the bottom of the card, at its end and wrapping onto more lines where they don't fit. For controls beside the title, use headerEnd.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The card opens something through a link or button inside, such as its title: it reacts to hover, keyboard focus on that target and presses. Mark the link or button `data-row-target` to stretch it over the card; the other links, buttons and fields in the card, such as an author's link in the description or a Menu in headerEnd, stay clickable above it.

props.name: render
props.description: The element for the card's meaning, such as render={<article />} or render={<section />}. A div by default.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination: the whole card is one native link, through the LinkProvider.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs when the card is pressed: the whole card is one native button.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled link card has no destination, cannot be focused and reports aria-disabled; a disabled button card cannot be pressed.

Checkbox.description: A native checkbox inside its label, checked, unchecked or mixed.

props.name: ref
props.description: The native checkbox, so that a form library can register it and focus it; the other native props, such as name and required, reach it too.

props.name: className
props.description: The checkbox's class, on its root element, the label around the box and the text.

props.name: style
props.description: Styles of the root element.

props.name: label
props.description: The text beside the box, which names the checkbox; pressing it toggles the checkbox. Without it, a List.Item whose control it is names it, or name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: description
props.description: A short, muted line under the label, such as what the option changes. It is part of the checkbox's label, so it is read with its name.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description: Where the label sits beside the box: end, after it, or start, before it, such as in an inline row whose label leads; the native label still names the checkbox.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the box is checked, unchecked or "mixed", for a parent whose children are partly chosen. With `onCheckedChange` it controls the checkbox.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: How an uncontrolled checkbox starts, and what a form reset restores; unchecked by default.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when people press the checkbox; a mixed checkbox reports true.

Code.description: Inline source in the code theme of the app theme, the nearest Theme boundary's; use CodeBlock for multiline source.

CodeBlock.description: Source, a command or output as plain text in the code theme of the app theme, such as a command to copy; copy always uses the original string. It loads no highlighter: HighlightedCodeBlock, from `@envsemble/envui/code`, colors a language's syntax. Its words come from EnvUIProvider's messages.codeBlock.

props.name: children
props.description: The source, as one string; it is shown and copied as it is.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the block in its heading and for assistive technology, such as a file name, or content such as a file-type icon and a path link. Without one, the code takes the generic name of its language, such as Plain text code or TypeScript code, from messages.codeBlock.label.

props.name: headerEnd
props.description: Content at the end of the heading, before the copy button, such as Open in editor, Run, or a switch between npm, pnpm and yarn, placed as given.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Shows a copy button in the heading that copies the source; false by default.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling them; false by default.

CodeDiff.description: The changes between two versions of a file, rendered by Diffs (diffs.com) in the code theme of the app theme, as code blocks are; the whole file when nothing changed.

props.name: before
props.description: The source before the change.

props.name: after
props.description: The source after the change.

props.name: filename
props.description: Names the file in the header and chooses its language, such as form.json.

props.name: language
props.description: Overrides the language the file name implies, such as json.

props.name: header
props.description: Shows the file header with its name and change counts; true by default.

props.name: expandUnchanged
props.description: Shows the unchanged lines between changes instead of folding them; false by default.

props.name: layout
props.description: auto (default) sets old and new side by side from 56 rem of width; split always sets them side by side, such as for a split and unified toggle; unified keeps one column.

props.name: headerEnd
props.description: Content at the end of the file header, such as View file, Accept or Revert, or a status Badge.

props.name: annotations
props.description: Notes attached to lines, such as review comments, which renderAnnotation draws under them.

props.name: renderAnnotation
props.description: Draws one of annotations under its line.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The level of the heading of what shows when the diff fails to load, for the page's outline.

ColorPicker.description: A compact color picker on React Aria's color hooks: a square saturation and brightness area with a vertical hue slider, and an alpha slider with `alpha`, at its side; under them, a format select, the browser's eyedropper where it has one, a copy button, and fields for the chosen format, or the fields of several `formats` together, each with its own copy button; and preset swatches. Every part works with the keyboard; the channels and the area are named in the EnvUIProvider's language.

props.name: visibleLabel
props.description: The label shows above the picker. false hides it where something else names the picker, such as the popover around it: the label still names the picker for assistive technology.

props.name: description
props.description: Lasting guidance under the picker, such as where the color shows.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the picker that says what is wrong with the color, such as too little contrast.

props.name: label
props.description: The color's name, such as Accent color; it names the picker, and ColorPickerButton's popover and button.

props.name: value
props.description: The color in a controlled picker: a CSS color string, such as #6750a4, rgb(103, 80, 164) or hsl(256, 34%, 48%), or React Aria's Color; update it from onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The color an uncontrolled picker starts at, and that a form reset restores.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the color as it changes, as a string in valueFormat, such as #6750a4.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: The format of the string onValueChange receives and a form submits: hex (#rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa while translucent), rgb (rgb() or rgba()) or hsl (hsl() or hsla()).

props.name: formats
props.description: The formats whose fields show together, one under another in this order, such as `['hex', 'rgb', 'hsl']`. With one, the picker shows that format alone; without the prop, it shows one format at a time, hex first, with a select that switches to RGB or HSL.

props.name: alpha
props.description: Whether the color has an alpha: a slider and a field for its opacity, and a value with its alpha while translucent. Without it, colors are opaque.

props.name: eyeDropper
props.description: Whether to show the eyedropper, which picks a color from the screen, where the browser has one (Chromium-based browsers on the desktop); elsewhere it never shows.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Whether to show the button that copies the color, as the fields show it.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset colors to choose from, under the fields: CSS color strings, React Aria's Colors, or `{ color, label }` with a name, such as the colors of a brand.

props.name: swatchesFirst
props.description: Show the swatches first, above the area and the fields, for a picker where presets are the usual choice, such as a tag's color.

props.name: fields
props.description: Whether to show the row of value fields, with the format select, the eyedropper and the copy button; without it, the area, the sliders and the swatches choose the color.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the color with a form under this name, as a string in valueFormat.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form the color submits with, where the picker sits outside it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the picker takes no input, faded.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether people can read and copy the color, but not change it.

ColorPickerButton.description: A compact button that shows a color as a swatch and its value, and opens a ColorPicker in a Popover: the common way to choose a color in a toolbar, a row or a form. The button is named after the label and the color, such as Accent color, #6750A4. className, style, ref and the other native props go to the button.

props.name: size
props.description: The button's height, as on every control; without it, its container's.

props.name: side
props.description: The side of the button the picker opens on.

props.name: align
props.description: How the picker lines up with the button along that side.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the picker is open, for a picker the application controls with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled picker starts open, such as in a picture of it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Receives the requested state, and why, as Popover's onOpenChange does: such as to close the picker once a swatch is chosen.

props.name: trigger
props.default: a button with a swatch and the value
props.description: The element that opens the picker in place of the swatch button, such as a text color button of a toolbar, an A over a bar of the color: an element, or a function that receives the color's value and returns one. It takes the native props given here, the opening behavior and, unless it has its own, the name after the label and the color; style it, and show the color, yourself.

props.name: label
props.description: The color's name, such as Accent color; it names the picker, and ColorPickerButton's popover and button.

props.name: value
props.description: The color in a controlled picker: a CSS color string, such as #6750a4, rgb(103, 80, 164) or hsl(256, 34%, 48%), or React Aria's Color; update it from onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The color an uncontrolled picker starts at, and that a form reset restores.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the color as it changes, as a string in valueFormat, such as #6750a4.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: The format of the string onValueChange receives and a form submits: hex (#rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa while translucent), rgb (rgb() or rgba()) or hsl (hsl() or hsla()).

props.name: formats
props.description: The formats whose fields show together, one under another in this order, such as `['hex', 'rgb', 'hsl']`. With one, the picker shows that format alone; without the prop, it shows one format at a time, hex first, with a select that switches to RGB or HSL.

props.name: alpha
props.description: Whether the color has an alpha: a slider and a field for its opacity, and a value with its alpha while translucent. Without it, colors are opaque.

props.name: eyeDropper
props.description: Whether to show the eyedropper, which picks a color from the screen, where the browser has one (Chromium-based browsers on the desktop); elsewhere it never shows.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Whether to show the button that copies the color, as the fields show it.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset colors to choose from, under the fields: CSS color strings, React Aria's Colors, or `{ color, label }` with a name, such as the colors of a brand.

props.name: swatchesFirst
props.description: Show the swatches first, above the area and the fields, for a picker where presets are the usual choice, such as a tag's color.

props.name: fields
props.description: Whether to show the row of value fields, with the format select, the eyedropper and the copy button; without it, the area, the sliders and the swatches choose the color.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the color with a form under this name, as a string in valueFormat.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form the color submits with, where the picker sits outside it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the picker takes no input, faded.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether people can read and copy the color, but not change it.

ColorSwatch.description: A small rounded sample of a color, with a hairline edge that keeps light and dark colors visible on every surface and a checkerboard under a translucent one. With `format`, it writes the color's value beside it, and with `label`, a name. Alone, it is an image named by the color's description, such as dark purple, in the EnvUIProvider's language; as a Button's icon it is decorative, and the button's text names the color.

props.name: color
props.description: The color it shows: a CSS color string, such as #6750a4, rgb(103, 80, 164) or hsl(256, 34%, 48%), with an optional alpha, or React Aria's Color.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes the color beside the sample in this format: hex, such as #6750A4, rgb or hsl. Without it and a label, the sample stands alone, named by the color's description, such as dark purple.

props.name: label
props.description: A name beside the sample, before the value, such as the label the color belongs to.

props.name: size
props.description: The sample's size: sm, 0.75 rem, for dense rows; md, 1 rem, the size of an icon. As a Button's icon it takes the icon's size.

Column.description: Lays its direct children out one under another, `gap` apart, such as a form's fields. A flex column that sizes to its content and never paints.

props.name: gap
props.description: The space between the direct children, a step of the spacing scale. None by default.

props.name: align
props.description: How the children line up across the line: stretch, the default, makes each as wide as a column or as tall as a row, except controls such as buttons, which keep their own size; start, center and end keep every child at its own size.

props.name: justify
props.description: Where the children sit along the line when there is room to spare: at the start, in the center, at the end, such as a form's actions, or between, spread out to the edges.

props.name: render
props.description: The element to render, for its meaning, such as render={<section />} or render={<ul />}, or another component to lay out without a wrapper, such as a Surface: the primitive's attributes merge into its props. It must forward native props and refs. A div by default.

props.name: ref
props.description: The rendered element, a div by default. Its type is the element type parameter, which a ref passed in sets: a ref to the element that render makes, such as useRef<HTMLElement>(null) with render={<section />}, type-checks.

props.name: name
props.description: A name for this node, such as "filters" or "summary", for the application's styles and tests to find it by; it renders as `data-env-name`. A component's part class names its node instead.

props.name: container
props.description: Makes the element a size container of this name, for container queries on its inline size, such as container="filters" for `@container filters (width >= 37.5rem)`. A container is as wide as its context gives it, never as its content. container="env-window" makes the element a window of its own on purpose, such as a preview frame, whose content lays out at its window class; other `env-*` names are envUI's own.

props.name: padding
props.description: The inset on every side, a step of the spacing scale. None by default.

Combobox.description: A text field that filters a list of options as people type, for choosing one option or several. Chosen options show as removable chips; keyboard, focus and announcements follow the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern.

props.name: ref
props.description: The text input, so that a form library can register it and focus it.

props.name: className
props.description: The field's class, on its root element, beside env-field and env-combobox.

props.name: style
props.description: Styles of the field's root element.

props.name: items
props.description: The options, or groups of options under headings, in display order.

props.name: filter
props.description: Which options match the typed text: by default those whose label or description contains it, ignoring case and accents. null shows the items as given, for searching on the server.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Receives the typed text, and an empty string once it is cleared, such as to search a server.

props.name: loading
props.description: The options are loading: the popup shows loadingLabel instead of emptyLabel.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Shown in the popup while loading.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown in the popup when no option matches.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear button removes the value while there is one; Esc on the closed field clears it too.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button.

props.name: removeLabel
props.default: Remove followed by the label, or EnvUIProvider's messages.combobox.remove
props.description: Accessible name of a chip's remove button, from the chip's label.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the list is open; with `onOpenChange` it controls the popup.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled list starts open; closed by default.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called as the popup opens and closes, and why, such as to load the options as it opens.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the default filter's matching: EnvUIProvider's, else the browser's.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible name, above the field, such as Project name; it also names the control for assistive technology.

props.name: description
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the description.

props.name: size
props.description: The control height, sm, md or lg; without it, the container's, and else md.

props.name: visibleLabel
props.description: The label shows above the field. false hides it, for a field whose purpose is clear without it, such as a search in a toolbar: the label still names the field for assistive technology, and a placeholder gives the visible guidance.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Several options can be chosen; they show as chips in the field.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen option's value, or null for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value an uncontrolled field starts with, and that a form reset restores; none by default.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ((value: string | null, item: Item | null) => void) | ((value: string[], items: (Item | ComboboxItem)[]) => void)
props.description: Receives the chosen value and its option, or null twice once the field is cleared.

CommandPalette.description: A quick-open dialog near the top of the window: a search field over a list of options the application filters and ranks. The arrow keys move the highlight while typing continues, and the number of results is announced as it changes. className, style, ref and data attributes go to the dialog's surface.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the palette is open; the application opens it, such as from a shortcut.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with false, and why, when Esc, a press on the backdrop or a choice closes the palette.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the dialog, the search field and the list.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The text in the search field.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Receives the text as people type.

props.name: items
props.description: Filtered and ranked by the application, in display order; or groups of items, each under a heading.

props.name: suggestedItems
props.description: Shown in place of items while the search field is empty, such as recent documents or suggested pages under a group heading; options like any other.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Enter or a press on an option; Ctrl or Cmd sets modifier.

props.name: closeOnAction
props.description: Close after an option is chosen.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty search field, such as "Search documents by name or folder".

props.name: loading
props.description: The results are on their way, such as from a server. A spinner shows at the search field's end; with no results to show yet, the empty state's line says loadingLabel, and results already shown stay, marked busy.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Shown and announced while loading.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.default: 'Type to search' while the search field is empty and 'No results' when its text finds nothing, or EnvUIProvider's messages.commandPalette.emptyQuery and empty
props.description: The title of the EmptyState shown in place of the list when there are no options, and announced.

props.name: emptyDescription
props.default: None while the search field is empty; when its text finds nothing, 'Nothing matches “…”. Check the spelling or try other words.', or messages.commandPalette.emptyHint
props.description: The empty state's description below its title, such as what the palette searches; null or false shows none.

props.name: emptyIcon
props.description: A decorative icon above the empty state's title, such as an error icon when the search failed; none by default.

props.name: hints
props.description: Key hints below the list, such as { keys: ['Enter'], label: 'Open' }. A hint with Enter in its keys hides while there is no option to choose.

props.name: footer
props.description: Other content below the list, after the hints.

props.name: searchStart
props.description: Content before the search field in its row, such as a scope chip, In: Projects.

props.name: searchEnd
props.description: Content after the search field in its row, before the close button, such as a mode switch.

Composer.description: The message field of a conversation: a multiline field on a raised surface that grows with its text up to maxRows, with a send button at the end that becomes a stop button while running. Enter submits, or with sendKey mod-enter Ctrl+Enter or ⌘+Enter; Shift+Enter starts a new line and an input method's composition never submits. Without onSend, Enter and the send button submit the field's form.

props.name: value
props.description: The message text of a controlled composer.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting text of an uncontrolled composer; it clears after each send through onSend and when its form resets.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the text as it changes, and an empty string when an uncontrolled composer clears.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Enter or the send button submits the text as typed, and an uncontrolled composer clears. Blank text never submits, and neither does a disabled, running or pending composer. Without onSend, they submit the field's form instead and the text stays until the form resets. Without onSend or a form there is nothing to send: the button is unavailable and Enter starts a new line.

props.name: pending
props.description: A send is in progress, such as a request the application makes: the send button shows a spinner and sending is unavailable, while the field keeps its text, stays editable and keeps focus. The pending action of an enclosing form counts too; set pending for a form the field joins through its form attribute, or for a request of the application's own.

props.name: running
props.description: A reply is on its way: the send button becomes a stop button and Enter does not submit.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called by the stop button while running; it stays available when the field is disabled.

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the send button.

props.name: stopLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the stop button.

props.name: minRows
props.description: Lines the field shows while empty; 1 by default.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Lines the field grows to before it scrolls; 8 by default.

props.name: start
props.description: Content at the start of the action row, such as an attach button or the name of a model.

props.name: end
props.description: Content in the action row just before the send button, such as a voice button, a model picker or a token count; the field then takes a row of its own above the action row.

props.name: header
props.description: Content inside the composer above the field, such as attachment chips, a quoted reply or context pills, placed as given.

props.name: sendKey
props.description: The key that sends: enter, where Shift+Enter starts a new line, or mod-enter, Ctrl+Enter or ⌘+Enter, where Enter starts a new line, for prompts that mostly take several lines.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text below the composer, such as a note on attachments; it describes the field.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the field, which has no visible label, such as "Message"; this or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of visible text that names the field; this or aria-label.

ConfirmButton.description: A button for an action that takes effect at once and cannot be undone. The first press arms it and names the consequence in place; a second press runs it. It disarms after a few seconds, when focus leaves and on Escape.

props.name: start
props.description: Content before the label, such as IconAdd, or a small Avatar of the person a button assigns: an envUI icon takes the button's icon size and other content keeps its own. It is hidden from assistive technology, since the label names the button.

props.name: end
props.description: Quiet content at the far end, such as a shortcut's Kbd, with aria-hidden on its keys and aria-keyshortcuts on the button.

props.name: size
props.description: The control height, sm, md or lg; without it, the container's, and else md.

props.name: pending
props.description: Its work is running: a spinner turns over it, it keeps its width and name, and presses do nothing.

props.name: underline
props.description: Show an underline for the text variant.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fill the width of the container, such as the actions of a narrow form stacked in a column.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: A decorative icon after the label, such as a ChevronRight for a next step.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The icon-only button's name at rest, such as Delete draft.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The label while armed: what a second press does, short and without a question mark, such as “Remove Morgan”.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs on the second press, while the button is armed.

props.name: armedDuration
props.description: How long the button stays armed without a second press, in milliseconds.

props.name: icon
props.description: A round icon-only button at rest, named by aria-label. Armed, it shows the icon with the confirm label, so the consequence is still named.

props.name: variant
props.description: The resting appearance; armed, the button is always variant="primary" tone="danger". Without it, the container's variant, such as ghost in a toolbar, and else outline, or secondary for an icon-only button, like IconButton.

props.name: tone
props.description: The resting meaning, as Button's: neutral, or danger on a primary, outline, ghost or text button.

ConfirmDialog.description: Asks people to confirm an action whose consequence needs a sentence, such as deleting a project: an alert dialog with a question, a description, Cancel and a confirm button that names the consequence. It waits for onConfirm's promise, pending, and stays open when it fails. className, style, ref and data attributes go to the dialog's surface.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open, for a dialog the application controls with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether a dialog the application doesn't control is open on the first render.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the requested state, and why, when the dialog opens or closes: from the trigger, Escape, Cancel, or after onConfirm finishes. Not called for a dismissal that a running onConfirm blocks.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the dialog, such as a Button. Omit it for a dialog the application opens with open, such as from a menu item.

props.name: title
props.description: The question, which names the dialog, such as “Delete Northwind launch?”.

props.name: description
props.description: What confirming does and whether it can be undone; it describes the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: More content between the heading and the actions, such as what else the action affects, or the one field a confirmation holds, such as a typed name. The dialog is a form: Enter in a field confirms as the confirm button does, through onConfirm. Hold no form here; use Dialog for one.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The confirm button's label: a verb that names the consequence, such as Delete project. Like a Button's content, it can hold more, such as a Kbd of its shortcut.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The cancel button's label.

props.name: tone
props.description: danger for an action that deletes or ends something: the confirm button is a danger one and focus starts on Cancel, so a hurried Enter doesn't confirm. neutral starts focus on the confirm button.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs the action when the confirm button is pressed, or Enter is pressed in a field in the dialog. The dialog closes when it returns, or, when it returns a promise, once the promise resolves; while it runs, the confirm button is pending and nothing dismisses the dialog. It runs once per opening: further presses, such as the second click of a double-click, are ignored until it fails or the dialog opens again. A rejected promise or a thrown error keeps it open and is passed to reportError, so show what went wrong with error.

props.name: confirmDisabled
props.description: Whether the confirm button is disabled, and Enter in a field doesn't confirm, such as for a confirmation that waits on a typed name.

props.name: error
props.description: What went wrong, shown as a danger Alert above the actions and announced.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: The element to focus when the dialog closes, such as the menu button whose item opened it: its ref, or a function of how the dialog was opened that returns it, as on Dialog. By default focus returns to the trigger, or to the element that had focus when it opened.

ContextMenu.description: Actions for an area, opened by right click, long press, the ContextMenu key or Shift+F10. In a contained PortalContainer, such as a preview of an interface, it is part of the container as its other overlays are: it opens by right click and the keyboard without hiding the page, locking its scroll or taking focus.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu, such as Document actions.

props.name: content
props.description: Menu content: Menu.Item, Menu.Group, Menu.Separator and the other menu parts. A function receives the element the menu was opened on: the deepest element under the pointer, or the focused element (its active descendant, when it has one) for the keyboard. Where it returns null, undefined, false or '', the menu doesn't open on that element and the browser keeps its own.

props.name: children
props.description: One element that becomes the region; it must accept native props and a ref.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The region keeps the browser's own context menu.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility, for example to open the menu from another control.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new visibility, and why, as the menu opens or closes.

props.name: anchorPoint
props.description: Viewport point to open at while controlled; otherwise the menu opens at the pointer.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the menu popup.

props.name: ref
props.description: The menu popup's ref; the region is the element you pass as children.

props.name: style
props.description: The menu popup's inline style.

CopyButton.description: Copies text to the clipboard. Icon-only by default, with its name in a tooltip, or a labelled button with children. After a press the icon becomes a check, and Copied shows in the tooltip and is announced for two seconds, or Couldn’t copy when the clipboard refuses.

props.name: value
props.description: The text to copy, or a function that returns it, also as a promise, when pressed.

props.name: onCopied
props.description: Runs once the text is on the clipboard, with that text.

props.name: write
props.description: Writes the text instead of the browser's Clipboard API, such as through a desktop app's clipboard bridge. A rejected promise shows and announces failedLabel.

props.name: size
props.description: As Button's: sm, md or lg; without it, the control height of the container.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon at rest, ContentCopy by default; a check replaces it once the text is copied.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Shown in the tooltip and announced after copying.

props.name: failedLabel
props.description: Shown in the tooltip and announced when nothing could be copied.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: The button's name, also in an icon-only button's tooltip, where it has none of its own: no aria-label or aria-labelledby, and a label without words, such as an empty string.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The icon-only button's name, such as Copy link, which its tooltip shows.

props.name: variant
props.description: The emphasis, as Button's. Without it, the button takes the variant its container gives, such as ghost in a toolbar, and else secondary.

props.name: tone
props.description: The meaning, as Button's.

props.name: children
props.description: Without children, or with children that render nothing, the button is icon-only, named by aria-label, such as Copy link; a blank one leaves it named by copyLabel.

DatePicker.description: A field for a date, or a date and time, that shows the value in the reader's locale and opens a calendar to choose it, with keyboard access following the WAI-ARIA date picker.

props.name: ref
props.description: The field's button, which shows the value and opens the calendar.

props.name: className
props.description: The field's class, on its root element, beside env-field and env-date-picker.

props.name: style
props.description: Styles of the field's root element.

props.name: value
props.description: The value: a day as YYYY-MM-DD, or with the minute granularity a local date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm. null, or an empty string, for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value an uncontrolled field starts with, and that a form reset restores; none by default.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the new value, or null once the field is cleared.

props.name: granularity
props.description: What the value holds: day, a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or minute, a date and a time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, chosen in a list of times beside the calendar.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest value, as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm; earlier days are unavailable.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest value, as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm; later days are unavailable.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: As Calendar's: whether a day, as YYYY-MM-DD, can't be chosen, such as a booked day.

props.name: renderDay
props.description: As Calendar's: the content of a day's mark in the calendar in place of its number.

props.name: placeholderTime
props.description: The time a newly chosen day starts with, as HH:mm; 00:00 by default.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: With the minute granularity, the minutes between the times the list offers, from 1 to 60. A value between them still shows in the list, in its place.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the shown value and the calendar's names and numbers: EnvUIProvider's, else the browser's. Dates are Gregorian, also in a locale with a calendar of its own.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: With the minute granularity, the clock of the shown time and the wheels, whatever the locale's: h23 for 18:00, with no AM/PM wheel, or h12 for 6:00 PM. The value stays on the 24-hour clock.

props.name: weekStart
props.default: the locale's, or Monday where the browser cannot tell
props.description: The calendar's first day of the week, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: How the field shows the value: Intl.DateTimeFormat options, by default the medium date style and, with the minute granularity, the short time style, in the Gregorian calendar unless they name another.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the value is submitted under with a form, as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

props.name: required
props.description: A value is needed: an empty field keeps its form from submitting and takes focus.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value can be read and focused but not changed.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field is empty and its label floats or is hidden.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear button in the field and in the calendar removes the value.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the calendar is open; with `onOpenChange` it controls it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled calendar starts open; closed by default.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state, and why, when the calendar opens or closes.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the field's clear button and text of the calendar's.

props.name: todayLabel
props.description: The calendar's shortcut to today.

props.name: nowLabel
props.description: With the minute granularity, the calendar's shortcut to the current date and time.

props.name: timeLabel
props.description: With the minute granularity, the heading and accessible name of the list of times.

props.name: previousMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the calendar's previous month button.

props.name: nextMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the calendar's next month button.

props.name: popupHeader
props.description: Content at the top of the popup, above the calendar, such as presets: buttons for Tomorrow or Next Monday that set the value, from a field the application controls.

props.name: popupFooter
props.description: Content in the popup's footer, after its shortcut to the current date or time and before Clear, such as a note of the time zone or another action.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible name, above the field, such as Project name; it also names the control for assistive technology.

props.name: description
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the description.

props.name: size
props.description: The control height, sm, md or lg; without it, the container's, and else md.

props.name: visibleLabel
props.description: The label shows above the field. false hides it, for a field whose purpose is clear without it, such as a search in a toolbar: the label still names the field for assistive technology, and a placeholder gives the visible guidance.

DescriptionList.Item.description: One term and its value: a `div` around a `dt` and a `dd`.

props.name: label
props.description: The term, such as Owner or Created.

props.name: children
props.description: The value: text, a link, a Badge, or a control in a list with `controls`.

DescriptionList.Root.description: A list of labelled values, the facts about one thing, such as a project's owner, status and dates: a `dl` whose items are its terms with their values.

props.name: layout
props.description: Where each label sits: inline, beside its value, in a column as wide as the longest label; stacked, above its value; auto, inline, stacked below 18 rem of the list's own width.

props.name: size
props.description: The text size: sm, the smaller body text, for facts beside other content, such as in a sidebar or a card; md, body text, for a page of details.

props.name: controls
props.description: The values hold controls, such as a Select or a Switch: each row is at least as tall as a small control, and its label sits on the control's first line.

Dialog.description: A focused task over the page: a centered modal, or a modal near the top of the window. It has a title, an optional description, content and actions that start with a built-in close button. Base UI's dialog owns focus, Escape and outside presses. className, style, ref and data attributes go to the dialog's surface.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open, for a dialog the application controls with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether a dialog the application doesn't control is open on the first render.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the requested state, and why, when the dialog asks to open or close: from the trigger, Escape, an outside press, the close button or a DialogClose. Not called for a dismissal that pending blocks.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the dialog, such as a Button. It reports the dialog it opens, and focus returns to it on close. Omit it for a dialog the application opens with open.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's heading and accessible name, such as “Delete project?”. Without one, such as for an image viewer or a search dialog its field names, name the dialog with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: description
props.description: Muted text under the title that describes the dialog to assistive technology too, such as what its action changes.

props.name: children
props.description: The content between the heading and the actions, such as text, fields or a list.

props.name: actions
props.description: The dialog's own actions, after the built-in close button, with the primary action last. They close the dialog only where they are DialogClose or set open to false. While the dialog is pending, the last one shows it, where it is a Button that sets no pending of its own; another component reads it with useDialogPending.

props.name: actionsStart
props.description: Content at the start of the actions' row, which takes the room the actions leave, such as a destructive Delete, a Learn more link or a Don't show again checkbox.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Whether the dialog shows its built-in close button, as on a Sheet. Leave it out only where the dialog places its own DialogClose.

props.name: closeButtonPlacement
props.description: Where the built-in close button is: actions, a secondary button that starts the actions; heading, an IconButton with a cross at the end of the heading, as on a Sheet.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The label of the built-in close button, such as Cancel, or its name in the heading.

props.name: headerStart
props.description: Content before the title in the heading's row, such as a back button.

props.name: headerEnd
props.description: Content at the end of the heading's row, before a close button there, such as a Menu of more actions or an Open full page button.

props.name: placement
props.description: center for a modal in the middle of the window; top for a modal near the top of the window for search-like tasks, so results grow downward without moving the field. For a panel at an edge of the window, use Sheet.

props.name: width
props.description: md, 28 rem wide, or lg, 44 rem, for content-heavy dialogs such as tables, comparisons and longer forms. Both narrow to fit the window.

props.name: modal
props.description: true traps focus in the dialog over a backdrop, hides the page from assistive technology, blocks presses on it and locks its scroll. false leaves the page usable beside the dialog; it then closes when focus or a press goes outside it, unless disablePointerDismissal.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: Keep the dialog open on presses outside it, and a non-modal dialog also when focus moves outside. Escape and the close buttons still close it.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: The element to focus when the dialog opens, as a ref or a function of how it was opened. By default focus moves to the first focusable element inside, such as the first field, or to the dialog itself when opened by touch.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: The element to focus when the dialog closes, such as the row that opened it. By default focus returns to the trigger, or to the element that had focus when the dialog opened.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work started from the dialog is in progress. Escape, outside presses and the close buttons cannot dismiss it until pending returns to false: the built-in close button and every DialogClose inside are disabled, the primary action, the last of actions, shows it pending, and the dialog reports busy.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Shows it and its content as a busy skeleton while that loads; turning it on or off renders the content anew.

DialogClose.description: A button inside a Dialog or a Sheet that closes it after its own onClick, for an action other than the built-in close button, such as Don't save or Done. It takes Button's props and is secondary by default, and is disabled while the dialog or sheet is pending.

props.name: variant
props.description: The emphasis, as Button's; secondary by default, as an action beside the dialog's main one.

props.name: tone
props.description: The meaning: neutral for most actions, danger for one that deletes or ends something, and accent, on a primary only, for a main action that must stand apart from the brand blue.

props.name: underline
props.description: Show an underline for the text variant.

props.name: size
props.description: The control height, sm, md or lg; without it, the container's, and else md.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fill the width of the container, such as the actions of a narrow form stacked in a column.

props.name: start
props.description: Content before the label, such as IconAdd, or a small Avatar of the person a button assigns: an envUI icon takes the button's icon size and other content keeps its own. It is hidden from assistive technology, since the label names the button.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: A decorative icon after the label, such as a ChevronRight for a next step.

props.name: end
props.description: Quiet content at the far end, such as a shortcut's Kbd, with aria-hidden on its keys and aria-keyshortcuts on the button.

props.name: pending
props.description: Its work is running: a spinner turns over it, it keeps its width and name, and presses do nothing.

props.name: render
props.description: Another element to render the button as, such as a label for a file input, or a router's own link in one place: the button's class, look, state attributes, content and handlers merge into its props. It takes no type or disabled attribute; disabled reports aria-disabled and blocks presses.

Disclosure.description: A summary that shows and hides the details below it, on the native details element.

props.name: title
props.description: The summary: one line that says what the details hold and opens or closes them.

props.name: children
props.description: The details, shown below the summary while the disclosure is open.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the details show, for a controlled disclosure: update it from onOpenChange. Use defaultOpen instead to leave it to the disclosure.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the details show at first, for a disclosure that keeps its own state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Receives whether the details show, each time the disclosure opens or closes.

props.name: indicatorPlacement
props.description: Where the chevron sits in the summary: before its words, or after them, as in a Show more link.

props.name: panelLayout
props.description: stack lays the details out one under another, a small gap apart; flow places them as given, so they keep their own spacing and flow, such as inline text.

DocumentTabs.description: Editor-style closable tabs for open documents, with the active document in a panel under them. className, style, ref and the other native props go to the root element, which holds the strip of tabs, the actions at its end and the panel.

props.name: children
props.description: The active document, in the panel under the strip, which the active tab joins: anything the application renders, such as an editor or a page, placed as given. Without it, the application renders the panel itself and names it with panelId.

props.name: items
props.description: The open documents, in tab order.

props.name: value
props.description: The active tab, or null.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the tab's value when it is clicked or reached with the arrow keys, Home or End.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called from a tab's close button, a middle click, Delete or Backspace on the focused tab, and Close in the tab's context menu.

props.name: onPin
props.description: Called when a tab is double-clicked, typically to keep a preview tab open.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: Called with every tab's value in the new order when a tab is dragged to another place with a mouse or pen, or moved with Move left or Move right in its context menu, which also reach the keyboard and touch. Without it, the tabs keep their order.

props.name: end
props.description: Content after the tabs, outside the strip that scrolls and in line with it, such as a button that closes every tab or opens a new one.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the tab strip.

props.name: panelId
props.description: Id of the panel the active tab controls: the one DocumentTabs renders around children, or the one the application renders itself.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The name of the context menu's item that closes a tab, and the tooltip of its close button, from the tab's text value.

props.name: onCloseAll
props.description: Called from Close all tabs in the context menu. Each tab opens a context menu that closes it on right click, long press, the Menu key and Shift+F10; with onCloseAll, the menu also offers Close all tabs, and the strip around the tabs opens it too.

props.name: closeAllLabel
props.description: Label of the Close all tabs item.

props.name: contextMenuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the context menu.

props.name: contextMenu
props.description: The application's own items for the context menu of the tab people open it on, or of the strip around the tabs when the tab is null, such as Close others or Copy path. They come after the built-in items, past a separator.

DropZone.description: A drop target for files that also opens the file picker; the application shows what was chosen.

props.name: label
props.description: What to drop or choose, such as "Drop a logo here, or browse". With the description, it names the zone, as its visible text does; without the target, only assistive technology reads it.

props.name: description
props.description: Which files fit, such as "PNG, JPG or WebP up to 2 MB"; it is read as part of the name.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the upload icon.

props.name: children
props.description: Content inside the zone, under its target, such as the chosen files with their previews and Remove buttons, or a Browse button that opens the file picker through inputRef. Files dropped on it are taken too; it can hold controls, since it is beside the target button, not inside it.

props.name: accept
props.description: The file types the zone takes, as in the native accept attribute: MIME types such as image/png, groups such as image/*, and extensions such as .webp.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Take several files at once; otherwise the zone takes the first file.

props.name: onFilesAccepted
props.description: Receives the dropped or chosen files that the zone takes.

props.name: onFilesRejected
props.description: Receives the files that do not match accept, and those after the first without multiple.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The zone can't be pressed or focused and takes no files; it still keeps the browser from opening dropped files.

props.name: pending
props.description: The application is working on the files: a spinner replaces the icon, the zone reports that it is busy and takes no new files.

props.name: error
props.description: A message linked to the zone, whose outline takes the error color.

props.name: size
props.description: md is the tall area with a large icon; sm is one row with a small icon, for a form or a sidebar.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits files with a native form under this name: the last files the zone took, until the form resets, or files.

props.name: files
props.description: The files a named zone submits when the application keeps them, such as after a Remove action; they replace the files the zone took, also after the form resets.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of a form the zone belongs to when it is outside of it.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: The native file input that opens the file picker, for example from a Replace button; ref reaches the zone itself.

props.name: target
props.description: Show the target: the button with the icon, the label and the description that opens the file picker. Without it, the zone is a group the label names, for content that has its own Browse button, which opens the picker through inputRef, such as a table the files land in.

props.name: render
props.description: Another element to render the zone as, such as the application's own panel or table region, which then takes dropped files: the zone's class, its state attributes, such as data-drag-over, and its handlers merge into its props.

EmptyState.description: What a region shows when it has nothing to show: an optional illustration or icon, a title, an optional description and optional actions, centred in the region it fills, and compact where that region is narrow.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon above the title, such as the icon of what the region would list, at the icon size of the region's width.

props.name: illustration
props.description: A decorative illustration above the title, such as an SVG drawing or an image, at its own size and no wider than the region, in place of the icon where both are given. It is hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: title
props.description: What the region would show, said as its absence, such as "No projects yet".

props.name: description
props.description: A sentence on why it is empty or what fills it, such as "Projects you create show here."

props.name: actions
props.description: What fills it, such as a Button that creates the first item, in a row that wraps.

EnvUIProvider.description: Sets the locale, the strings and the text direction of the envUI components inside it. envUI works without it, in English, in the runtime's locale and in each element's direction; an application that translates or formats for its people wraps itself, or a region, in one.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale envUI formats numbers, dates and relative times in, and reads plural rules, collation and the week's first day from, such as de-CH. Without it, the runtime's locale, from the browser once the page has hydrated.

props.name: messages
props.description: Overrides of envUI's built-in English strings, per namespace, such as `{ dialog: { close: 'Schließen' }, toast: { hidden: ({ count }) => t('hidden', { count }) } }`. A message is a string, or a function of the values it names. Nested providers merge per namespace, the inner winning; a component's own label prop, such as closeLabel, wins over both.

props.name: dir
props.description: The text direction for keyboard and placement logic, such as which arrow key moves forward and which side a popup's start is. Without it, each component reads the direction at its element, from dir attributes and CSS. It doesn't set the dir attribute: set that on the page or region.

props.name: children
props.description: The application, or the part of it that takes these messages, locale and direction.

Field.Control.description: The control: a native text input in the outlined field look by default, or any control through render, such as render={<MyControl />}, which receives the control's props, id and ref. A custom control styles itself; the class env-field-control gives it the field's outline.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
